raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 28
, Reason for Mistake: Provided an unsupported “~59 million” total penguin population as the Wikipedia upper estimate without evidencing or computing it from the page. The cited page lists species-level ranges and (in 2012) lacks a single “total,” so the correct approach was to sum the upper bounds of the species estimates for that date. Using this unverified/likely incorrect denominator led directly to the wrong final percentage.
